name: Paratrooper Hunt - VR Shooting Game
summary:
Prepare for intense combat in Paratrooper Hunt – VR Shooting Game, an action-packed virtual reality shooter that challenges your precision and reflexes. Armed with powerful weapons, you must defend the skies by targeting enemy jets, helicopters, and waves of paratroopers dropping in from above.
